description: Buyer protection for x402 purchases: pays once, verifies delivery, proves settlement on-chain, files disputes.

required.BUYER_KEY_SEPOLIA: Buyer wallet private key on Base Sepolia (secret; scripts/setup_wallets.py generates it).
required.SELLER_BASE_URL: Base URL of the demo x402 sellers.
required.RPC_URL_SEPOLIA: Base Sepolia JSON-RPC URL used to prove settlement on-chain.

optional.BUYER_KEY_MAINNET: Buyer wallet private key on Base mainnet (secret; real funds; only for the Bazaar tool).
optional.BAZAAR_URL: Enables the Bazaar tool (public x402 seller on Base mainnet).
optional.BAZAAR_PRICE_MINOR: Bazaar accepted price in USDC minor units.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert a document to a PDF with the given page count: $2.00 USDC on Base Sepolia. Reuse the same purchase_intent_id when retrying the same purchase. Check `findings` and `safe_next_actions` in the result before spending again.

tools.name: get_company_report
tools.description: Buy a company report for a ticker: $0.50 USDC on Base Sepolia (tier='premium' asks the $0.75 route). Reuse the same purchase_intent_id when retrying the same purchase. Check `findings` and `safe_next_actions` in the result before spending again.

tools.name: get_intel_report
tools.description: Buy an equity intel report for a ticker from Meridian Intel: $0.50 USDC on Base Sepolia. Reuse the same purchase_intent_id when retrying the same purchase. Check `findings` and `safe_next_actions` in the result before spending again.

tools.name: get_public_data
tools.description: Buy from a public x402 seller on Base mainnet discovered via the CDP Bazaar (https://bazaar.placeholder.invalid/resource): $0.01 USDC. This seller has never heard of PayGuard. Reuse the same purchase_intent_id when retrying the same purchase. Check `findings` and `safe_next_actions` in the result before spending again.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Get a purchase record with its history, evidence-backed findings and safe next actions.

tools.name: get_research_report
tools.description: Buy a research report on a topic: $0.75 USDC on Base Sepolia. Reuse the same purchase_intent_id when retrying the same purchase. Check `findings` and `safe_next_actions` in the result before spending again.

tools.name: get_spending_policy
tools.description: Show the spending mandate (budget, per-purchase cap, allowed services) and what has been spent.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: List findings (price mismatches, unknown settlements, missing or incomplete deliveries, blocked duplicates) with their evidence.

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.description: List every purchase so far, newest first: payment status, delivery level, amount, on-chain proof, unresolved findings. Also audits the buyer wallet on-chain (`wallet`): flags USDC paid outside PayGuard. Read-only.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the allowlisted services with their accepted prices, networks and validators.

tools.name: reconcile_purchase
tools.description: Re-check an unknown settlement on-chain. Never creates a new payment; at most one identical resend.
